title: Asset pipeline ships unused JavaScript or CSS
summary: Rails asset configuration ships unused bundles or duplicate dependencies to many pages.
rationale: Excess frontend assets increase bandwidth, parse time, and client energy use.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Split bundles by page need, remove unused dependencies, and use modern asset analysis.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
